messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Costa <elena.costa@finova.eu>, Kenji Sato <kenji.sato@mercasia.jp>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Finova discovery — model fit & locale requirements (recap + asks)

Hi Elena / Kenji —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Short recap and concrete asks so we can scope a focused pilot:

Recap (what you told us)
- Primary production scope: user-facing financial assistance and KYC helpdesk in EU markets (FR/DE/ES/IT) + exploratory APAC rollout for JP/KR support.
- Quality bar: high factuality on balance/account queries, conservative hallucination tolerance for regulatory content, and native-level fluency in target locales.
- Latency SLO: p95 generation < 500ms for short answers (<= 80 tokens) in Dedicated or Private.
- Data controls: logs retained for 90 days; need SOC2-equivalent evidence and audit log samples.

Open questions / asks for you
1) Priority locales — please confirm top 3 languages for pilot (we heard FR / DE / JP as likely).
2) Example volume — rough estimate of monthly requests per locale (customer support vs product usage).
3) Any closed-source on-prem constraints for JP pilot (Mercasia involvement)?

What we propose next (short pilot + eval)
- Deliverables: (a) model shortlist + perf profiles (latency, token cost, quantization tradeoffs), (b) locale prompt bundle + fuzzed test set, (c) small human evaluation for regulatory-sensitive prompts.
- Timeline: 2-week technical fit run (benchmarks + smoke tests) followed by a 1-week human review.
- Shortlist we expect to test initially: rw-multi-13b-q4 (balanced latency/quality), mistral-instruct-7b-lite (low-cost APAC), rw-6.7b-eu-8bit (EU-optimized quantized variant).

Attachments: prompt pack stub and locale bench CSV attached for your review (finova_prompt_pack_v1.zip, locale-bench-csv-2026-11-28.csv).

Next steps I can take this week
- Spin up a 7-day Dedicated eval with the three models above and run locale-specific throughput/latency profiles.
- Share an action matrix and HubSpot deal link for approval.

Can you confirm the priority languages and an estimate of monthly requests? Once confirmed, I’ll attach the short action matrix and proposed pilot dates.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0143

Thanks Rishi — helpful summary. Quick answers:
- Priority languages for pilot: French, German, Japanese (FR/DE/JP) — Spanish and Italian are important but second wave.
- Monthly estimate: Support channel ~35k queries/month across EU; product in-app assistance ~120k UA/month (we expect 5–10% touchpoints). For JP, low volume initially (~3k/mo) but strategic.
- On-prem: For JP pilot we prefer cloud but Mercasia will require a network diagram and a short KBA on data residency.

Can you confirm whether the 2-week bench will include human-in-the-loop prompts for regulatory questions, and whether the EU-optimized variant supports our latency target at p95?

Elena

Head of Product, Finova
elena.costa@finova.eu

Elena — thanks, that helps. Short answers: yes, the 2-week technical run includes targeted human review for the top 20 regulatory prompts you flagged (we’ll run a small panel for FR/DE/JP).

Proposal (concrete)
- Pilot scope: 2-week automated benchmark (latency, token cost, semantic-sim, safety filters) + 1-week human review on ~200 high-risk prompts.
- Model shortlist (what we’ll spin up):
  * rw-multi-13b-q4 — expected quality/latency sweet spot for EU languages; we’ve seen p95 ~ 420–480ms on Dedicated for <=80-token answers in similar setups.
  * mistral-instruct-7b-lite — strong for English + JP cost tradeoffs; faster with 4-bit quantization.
  * rw-6.7b-eu-8bit — EU-optimized variant with tighter tokenization for Romance/Germanic languages and compliant runtime profiles.

- Deliverables next week:
  1) Eval action matrix (owner, deliverable, due date) — attached: eval-action-matrix-v1.xlsx
  2) Drive folder with prompt sets and expected human labels: https://drive.google.com/finova/prompt-sets-v1
  3) HubSpot deal card updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FIN-2026-0921

Notes on regressions / quality watchlist
- German compound splitting can cause degradation on smaller quantized variants — we’ll add compound-aware tokenization checks.
- French formal vs casual style differences — we’ll include human rating buckets for register.
- Japanese honorific/context errors — flagged as high-risk for customer-facing templates; recommend higher sampling rate in human review.

Operational asks for you
- Sign-off on pilot languages (FR/DE/JP) — Elena confirmed.
- Share 8–10 regulatory templates you want in the 200-prompt human set (we can redact PII).

Next steps (this week)
- Neha / Ben will provision Dedicated eval and schedule the baseline runs.
- I’ll post the action matrix and a proposed 2-week calendar.
